title: AnyaStateV01
description: v0.1 shared state board schema. State machine = Anya. Panam = current drone.

version.description: Schema version. Bump only on breaking changes.

timestamp.description: Unix epoch seconds (float ok). Updated on every successful write.

mode.description: High-level drone mode. Mirrors AMM/companion commands the game can execute.

type.description: What the current mode is aimed at.

value.description: null for none/player; [x,y,z] for position; entity id/string for entity.

text.description: Line for the body to speak / display. Empty = no active line.

emotion.description: Optional emotion/voice tag for later animation or TTS mapping.

timeout.description: Seconds the line should remain active before clearing.

seq.description: Monotonic dialogue sequence. Game executor only speaks when seq changes.

flags.description: Loose event bits. Game or heuristics set/clear; agent may read.

memory_delta.description: Small facts the agent wants stored or forgotten. Consumed by memory layer.

goal.description: Human-readable current goal for heuristics and agent context.

attention.description: What she is currently attending to (player, threat, object, etc.).

animation.description: Optional pose/animation name the game side already understands.

seq.description: Monotonic board revision. Incremented on every successful write.
